Run the Route Analysis

Source: R/route_analysis.R
run_route_analysis.Rd

Pools the repeated country and place questions of 4Mi - transit countries (Q47-Q54, with Q72 and QN8), places stopped (Q56-Q70) and most dangerous locations (Q98-Q117) - and analyses them across all slots. Turned on per block by the transit_country, places_stop and dangerous_location settings; run_analysis_spec() calls this when any of them is TRUE.

Usage

run_route_analysis(
  dataset,
  spec,
  blocks = ck_route_enabled(spec$settings),
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

dataset

The dataset, with the ONA label row still on top (as for run_analysis_spec()).

spec

An analysis_spec from build_analysis_spec().

blocks

The blocks to run. Defaults to those the settings turn on.

verbose

Logical. Print progress. Default TRUE.

Value

A data frame, one row per cell, with block, block_title, section (writing order), level (overall, country, location), country, location, unit_n, variable, variable_label, group_var (NA for the undisaggregated table), group_var_value, choice, stat, n, n_total, n_w and n_w_total. NULL when no block is enabled or none could run.

Details

For each block the result has an overall section, then one section per country (most respondents first) and, for stops and dangerous locations, one per place within the country (the route_top_locations places with the most respondents). Every table is repeated for the gender variable (route_gender_var, default Q27) and for every grouping variable of the group_analysis sheet.

Percentages are of respondents. A respondent counts once per country or place however many slots name it, and a choice counts as selected there if it was selected in any of those slots. Weights come from weight_column.
